stem: Which quotation best expresses the author’s concession to the argument that plans cannot always be made spontaneously?

options.label: A
options.text: We think that it has to do with how scheduling structures time. (paragraph 12)

options.label: B
options.text: The only difference was that some of the participants had strict schedules, while others didn’t. (paragraph 15)

options.label: C
options.text: We found that structuring not only made the activity feel more like work, but also decreased participants’ desire to engage in them. (paragraph 16)

options.label: D
options.text: For those who do need to make plans days or weeks in advance, something called "rough scheduling" can work wonders. (paragraph 17)
